profile.headline: Sr. Principal C# Software Engineer, available for contract or full time (remote only)
profile.summary: Principal/architect Software Engineer with 20+ years of experience focusing on MS full-stack C# programming, MS ASP.Net, MVC web designs, OOA/OOD, RDBMS, GUI and internet technologies.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Architect and software implementor of a new innovative biotech product that helps solve the problem of putting EEG ‘big data’ into the cloud for medical professional to analyze and engage remotely.  Responsibilities included full architecture and design from scratch of all software systems.  Implementations utilized the full MS stack with ASP.Net 4.5 at the core, MS SqlServer on the backend, near real-time web responses using base64 encoding and GZip compressions and graphing performance with CanvasJS, CSS3.0.  Product is currently awaiting FDA approval processing with supporting patents.

positions.title: Senior C# Software Specialist
positions.description: Engaged as part of a business solutions team providing architecture, design and implementation on several premire fast track products to market including a biotech solution for the “Golden-hour” emergency response scenario.  Primary focus centered on server-side middleware implementation of an ASP.Net MVC 4.0 web project incorporating MSSQL, WFC, MS VS C#/Framework 4.0, JQuery, JQWidgets, Bootstrap and SignalR.  Tasks included general code designs and architectures, DB designs, middleware and front-end implementation and designs.  Assisted client in understanding proper design and architectures for a quick to market solution thru balance of an agile approach while leveraging some of the latest framework technologies and coding practices/patterns.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer/Senior Architect
positions.description: Performed as a principal and group leader among a small group of software developers supporting an advanced quantitative imaging cytometry instrumentation for cell-based and tissue-based analysis.  Tasks included feature implementations for a winforms based application and serveral hardware interfaces including a robot arm, A/D image acquisition board and sentry security.  Most of the software application components were developed with MS C#/.Net technologies while a smaller portion of the image processing components were developed with c++.   Standard and non-standard image processing protocols/algorithms were utilized to enhance and present the captured image data analysis.  Some of the other instrument hardware and software features included multiple channel laser ilumination and photo-diode detectors, multi-threaded interface for background image processing, modular workflow with analysis components, local non-database XML data near the terrabyte level and support for several image formats.  Daily interactions varied from working with the scientists on new features to deep code maintenance and mentoring the developers, all while maintaining a constant eye on high-level design decisions for both code, API’s and toolsets.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Engineer
positions.description: Consultant (C#.Net focus) within Software Engineering group of the Command and Control division performing multiple prototyping tasks ranging from security research and analysis topics to enterprise wide SOA analysis and design improvements.  Provided deep technical engagements and guidance to various customers including the Air Force, STATCOM and several other DOD branch offices who understand the benefits of an objective voice in technology knowledge.  Most notable prototype efforts include participation in design and development of an active deployment for the AF to assist in the homeland security’s mission control of UAV’s, and a conference demonstration at the MPUC for a working weather image overlay plugin to a highly regarded military tactical software mapping client.  Other tasks involved analysis research of entitlements security layers for SOA environments and a Google Earth mash-up client build to display flight path routes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – R&D
positions.description: As a key member to a small research and development team, I help establish a software production process from which several prototypes were realized.  Primary tasks have included introducing good practice methods and general software development processes (Agile), bringing on board a source code respository, supporting standard C#/.Net design practices, and purchasing and setting up automated build systems for a set of regression testing machines.  At times, provided advice on software tool requisitions, aided in general architecture and design for implementations, and performed many beta releases for one of the department’s main products thru out a full year.  This included implementing all the new features, fixing countless bugs and working thru any modifications related to stabilizing it’s multi-threading issues.  Main prototyping duties included C#/.Net coding of spectral image analysis software, input for user interface usability cases and full implementation of GUI designs utilizing an internal plug-in technology for rapid prototyping designs.  Latest prototype was an automated slide scanning microscope system of which I took from initial concept thru to prototype finalization including all hardware interfaces, architectural designs and all automation implementations.  With sub-micron stage movement, multiple motorized lens facilities and CCD driven spectral analysis capture system, this product proved to be a fine addition to my professional experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principle tasks involved design and implementation of enhancements for a real-time stock market software primarily utilizing Microsoft Visual C++/C# technologies.  This software product was a three-tier, client-server solution having an MS SQL DB for the backend and several server components which provided near instantaneous stock order thru-put for both Clearing-house brokers and end-users.  After a year of enhancements to the original design, responsibilities shifted to included evaluation of MS .Net technologies for a porting of this product to C# to take advantage of solutions to a limited connection bandwidth.  As a core member to the design team, a conversion of every component was done from C++ to C#.  New .Net web technologies 

and the latest security interfaces were utilitzed to increase the server connection counts, broadening the bandwidth as well providing a more substantial user interface.  In addition to implementation, this position often required mentoring of junior members of a small but highly skilled team in a fast paced client support environment related to the financial industry.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Core member of a small design group, which architected a new internet software product from UML/OOD thru to its final implementation phase.  This product utilized many third party components and technologies, most notably, MFC/C++, the Rogue Wave Tools++/DBTools++, TAO CORBA, IBM’s Xerces XML parser, IBM’s ICU international conversion libs, XML, DHTML, CGI in C, Microsoft’s Internet Explorer activeX browser engine and the GO++’s workflow ActiveX component, MS SQL Server, IIS, and ODBC.  As a member of the team, I was responsible for the designs and implementations with almost all of the technologies to bring this product to its final tested phase.  Our milestones were met and the results were nothing short of a fantastic new type of real time collaboration tool for the Internet.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Contract
positions.description: Designed and implemented database architecture and GUI for a software product, which was to be sold along with a medical diagnostics device, related to breast cancer palpation screening.  Application design was based on UML/OOD, MFC Doc/View architecture and DAO with embedded SQL for MS Access.  This product was slated to pass FDA approval and therefore required strict enforcement of testing multi-levels to pass government regulations as well as ISO9000 compliance.  This included ‘white-box’ (unit)testing, ‘black-box’ and proactive assertion and exception handling.  This product was brought to its final stages of implementation, on time and within budget.
